Anthropic $ANT is going to go public with 4 separate share classes

This is what that's going to look like:

- Class F: 1 share held by the 7 co-founders, with 50.1% of the vote
- Class A: public investors, employees, and others, with 1 vote per share, capped at 49.9% combined
- Class T: 1 share held by the Long-Term Benefit Trust, which elects a majority of the board
- Class N: strategic partners and Anthropic's public benefit fund, with no vote
